description: T23 TiDB 8.5 physical layout / ID / cache table operations. OFFLINE IMPLEMENTATION CANDIDATE — no native case has run and none may be claimed. Modeled offline: spec.AutoRandomColumnVerdict (v8.5.0 setTableAutoRandomBits + NewShardIDFormat) shared by ddl.tidb.table.auto_random.valid and applyCreateTable — refused CREATEs keep pre-state, undecidable clustered premises invalidate; spec.CreateTableOptionOutcome (handleTableOptions) for AUTO_RANDOM_BASE / AUTO_ID_CACHE / SHARD_ROW_ID_BITS / PRE_SPLIT_REGIONS shared by ddl.tidb.table.options.valid and state publication — authored values publish unchanged, source clamps are effective-state normalization only; auto_increment.require is policy-parameterized (accept_tidb_auto_random, unset = strict literal, shipped default true), unsigned.require stays literal; MySQL keeps the vendor boundary on CREATE and ALTER; ALTER-side auto_random/option mutability stays bounded unaudited pending R2.6; CACHE/NOCACHE, ATTRIBUTES, TiFlash replica remain inventory-pending (TiFlash success paths require a real TiFlash store — a unistore store-count=0 proves only a negative). metadata_cases are EXPECT-FILLED restricted-fixture experiments grouped by the narrowed authorization card: A = AUTO_RANDOM/ID SQL + formal provider reads + clustered-mode comparison + minimal MySQL vendor negative + AUTO_RANDOM_BASE controls; B = CACHE/ATTRIBUTES with backend/state prerequisites confirmed before any effect claim; C = TiFlash declaration vs replica count vs store capability vs asynchronous availability — requires the real service, missing-service cases stay explicitly incomplete.
